summary: Allow interactive setup to edit an existing stopped node without recreating its identity
details: Existing setup loads current defaults for Explorer queries, optional Ord, resources, Bitcoin inbound access and firewall policy. Dedicated configuration commands remain available; role, mining identity and peer changes retain their dedicated flows.

Unchanged answers preserve the configuration and resource journal. Confirmed edits validate a private candidate, retain a mode-0600 backup and replace node.env without regenerating credentials, moving data, selecting release images or reinstalling controllers.

Running or unobservable services and pending node operations block edits. Changes apply on the next startup; release activation and host firewall application remain explicit actions with command guidance.
